action: TA-07 Canada/United Kingdom Merchant launch: documentation requirement review only

conclusion.verified: Google documents manual shipping estimates and requires complete, correct shipping speed and cost information. Its ordinary manual setup and free-listing eligibility instructions do not list historical delivered orders, tracking uploads, or a minimum delivered-order cohort as prerequisites.
conclusion.inferred: The blanket assumption that CA/GB free listings must wait for past delivered-order proof is not supported by these official instructions. An existing truthful, applicable, operationally supported policy may support manual estimates without historical deliveries; this is a synthesis of the documented manual route and accuracy requirements, not a guarantee of account approval.
conclusion.unknown: This documentation review does not establish DLM's actual fulfillment capability, current CA/GB shipping settings, website consistency, country eligibility, or launch readiness.

sources.title: Set up shipping settings for an entire account
sources.paraphrase: Manual speeds use cutoff/time zone, handling range and business days, and transit range or zones. CA and UK support postal-code speed regions. Shipping currency must match product currency. Product overrides and API/Shopify updates can supersede manual settings. UK carrier rates concern cost.

sources.title: Set up estimated delivery time
sources.paraphrase: The manual process supplies handling and transit business-day ranges; cutoff affects the arrival calculation. Cutoff is optional with a documented default. No historical-order step or minimum delivery count appears in this process.

sources.title: Shipping [shipping]
sections: Shipping from outside the target country
sources.quote: Submit complete and correct shipping information, including speed and costs.
sources.paraphrase: Shipping costs are required for CA/UK free listings. Costs must include applicable merchant shipping charges and may be conservatively overstated when exact cost cannot be represented. Destination coverage must reflect reality. Cross-border customs charges must be disclosed where applicable; government import duties are not shipping costs.

sources.title: Free listings for products
sources.paraphrase: CA/UK require account shipping settings or shipping costs in product data. Policies and product requirements also apply. The free-listing status permits showing products but does not guarantee display. No delivered-order-history prerequisite is listed.

sources.title: Calculate shipping speeds based on the carrier
sources.paraphrase: Merchant handling information plus origin, destination and selected carrier/service drive calculated transit estimates. The detailed eligibility page lists domestic US, DE and FR, not CA/GB. It does not specify merchant delivery-history uploads for this carrier-transit route.

sources.title: Link a partner with your Merchant Center account
sources.paraphrase: Optional partner linking supplies order tracking history for personalized shipping-speed improvements and annotation validation. The documented linking eligibility includes US customers and supported partners. This history-dependent feature is separate from manual estimates.

sources.title: About automatic shipping updates
sources.paraphrase: Automatic updates can use crawled site information and historical tracking/performance data. The page says these updates currently take effect in the US; merchants outside it may opt in. This is not a manual-setup prerequisite.

sources.title: How to fix: Inaccurate shipping costs
sources.paraphrase: Merchant rates below checkout rates can trigger account warnings or suspension. Match checkout rates; a slight overestimate is allowed when exact configuration is impractical. This exception concerns cost, not permission to invent delivery speeds.

sources.title: Free listings policies
sources.paraphrase: Free listings and their relevant purchase information must be truthful and not misleading.

source_access.method: Public Google Merchant Center Help via web tool only; no account or browser access
source_access.evidence_form: Short bounded quotes and paraphrases with direct URLs; no full-page archive

distinctions.result: Merchant inputs define the estimate. Current instructions prescribe values and accuracy, not a specific evidence packet, prior sales minimum, or tracking integration.
Carrier/location inputs and merchant handling data determine transit. Do not conflate this with carrier-rate cost calculation or history-based performance estimates.
Tracking history supports these optional automated improvements and certain annotations; its data needs do not transfer to the ordinary manual path.

A truthful policy plus a current feasible fulfillment basis can support manual settings. Delivered orders are useful calibration when available, not the sole permissible basis. Publishing a policy alone does not make an unsupported promise true.
No DLM account notice or specialized review requirement was inspected. An explicit current Google request, if any, must be evaluated separately; generic documentation cannot waive it.

documentation_qualification.detail: The broad account setup page labels carrier speed US-only, while the detailed carrier-speed page lists domestic US/DE/FR. Neither includes CA/GB. Do not generalize the broad label to all countries or treat UK carrier-cost availability as UK carrier-speed availability.

Parent separately decides exact country/source scope under existing authorization; this receipt neither approves nor performs release.

For any separately authorized change, exact target after-state and relevant storefront/checkout behavior must be read back; product eligibility or exposure must not be inferred from merely saving settings.

revision_history.scope: Original manual-estimate and historical-order requirement review; findings retained below.

sources_added.title: What shipping information do I need to provide?
sections: You can also submit shipping information with your product data
sources_added.quote: Handling and transit times configured at the account level will be ignored even if those values aren’t included in your product data.
sources_added.paraphrase: The general account-setup introduction asks for delivery times. Its explicit item-level exception says a shipping cost overrides account handling/transit even if product data omits them. CA shipping costs exclude tax.

sources_added.title: Set up your return policies for Shopping ads and free listings
sections: Add return policy label attribute to products
sources_added.paraphrase: Submitting policy data is a choice; visible website returns/refund terms must remain accessible, clear and consistent. Google can obtain policies from the website. Omitting a label can use a configured default; verified uploaded policies take precedence over crawled ones.

sources_added.title: Returns [returns]
sources_added.paraphrase: Offer-level returns data is optional and highly recommended. Submitted values must accurately match the website. Optional parent attributes do not make sub-attributes optional once a return override is submitted.

sources_added.title: Return policy label [return_policy_label]
sources_added.paraphrase: This optional label selects a non-default policy; without it, an existing configured default applies. Blank labels are not a way to clear or isolate return policies.

sources_added.title: How to fix: Missing shipping sub-attribute
sources_added.paraphrase: The shipping price remains usable when handling or transit is absent. The three fields needed for delivery-date calculation are price, maximum handling time and maximum transit time. A partial time declaration can produce an invalidated-time warning.

sources_added.title: About Shipping Confidence Values
sections: How CVs affect your product listings
sources_added.paraphrase: Google evaluates account/offer configurations, crawled website data and modeled estimates; inconsistent data can be suppressed or replaced. Listings without shipping speeds are explicitly discussed, with possible ranking/annotation disadvantages.

findings.claim: A matching offer-level shipping price suppresses inherited account shipping service times, even when time fields are omitted.
findings.scope: Documented configured-data precedence for that product and matching destination only; it does not erase the account service.

findings.claim: A cost-only shipping value is supported. Supplying time values is conditional on asking Google to calculate a delivery date from those fields.
findings.scope: Specific price-only support qualifies the general account-setup wording. It does not excuse inaccurate information or imply that all delivery details are universally unnecessary.

findings.claim: CA:::0.00 CAD and GB:::0.00 GBP fit the documented plain shipping TSV four-position form.
findings.conditions: Correct plain shipping header; one intended service per destination; currency matches each offer; exact full coverage and unconditional free delivery are factually supported. Different custom headers, XML or API payloads need their corresponding representation.

findings.claim: Submitting return-policy data in Merchant Center is recommended/optional for ordinary free listings, not a general CA/GB eligibility prerequisite.
findings.scope: No CA/GB-specific mandate for that submission is stated in these documents. Clear website returns/refund information and applicable policy/legal obligations remain.

findings.claim: Omitting return_policy_label does not suppress an existing default return policy or guarantee that no return information appears.
findings.scope: Return inheritance is separate from the shipping-price override. Existing applicable defaults, product returns data and crawled website policies must be considered.

findings.claim: No inherited account ETA is a justified narrow expectation; no Google-displayed ETA anywhere is not.
findings.scope: Other effective item attributes, enrichment and Google's crawled/modeled data can matter. The US-only automatic-update documentation must not be generalized into proof that CA/GB cannot display derived data.

challenged_or_rejected_assertions: REJECT: Historical delivered-order evidence is mandatory before any ordinary manual CA/GB free-listing launch.
REJECT: Cost-only overrides leave the old account handling/transit times inherited by the matching offer.
REJECT: Price-only syntax proves effective processed attributes, factual free-shipping coverage, or country/source readiness.
REJECT: Omitting return_policy_label removes any existing/default/crawled return information.
REJECT: Omitting times guarantees Google will never show an ETA or makes unsupported website delivery promises acceptable.
QUALIFY: The account-setup requirement for delivery information is not a prohibition on the specifically documented offer-level cost-only override.
